meta.name: pricing-packaging-tracker
meta.description: Track competitor pricing and packaging as a diffable time series. Use when monitoring tiers, gates, limits, and price moves on a monthly or quarterly cadence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪竞品定价与套餐变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期监控竞品价格和套餐调整。
copy.tagline_en: Track competitor pricing and packaging changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly monitor competitor pricing and packaging changes.

howto.what: 抓取竞争对手公开定价页,存入固定格式;与上次记录逐项对比,报告所有变动——层级、价格、功能门槛、套餐结构,并附证据链接与日期。若没有上次记录,先做全量快照供下次对比。
howto.when: 当你需要按每月或每季度节奏监控竞品定价,关注层级、门槛、限额等变化时触发;直接报竞品名单或附上次抓取记录即可启动。

say.text: 追踪 A、B、C 三家竞品的定价页,附上次 4 月的记录,做差异对比。
say.note: 进入 delta 模式,只报告变化项。

say.text: 这季度我们追踪的五家对手里,有谁改了价格或套餐门槛?
say.note: 技能会抓取页面并输出本周期变化。

say.text: 先给这三家竞品各做一份定价基线快照。
say.note: 进入 baseline 模式,全量记录,下次再对比。

howto.what_en: Captures competitors' public pricing pages into a fixed schema, diffs against the previous capture, and reports what moved — tiers, prices, gates, packaging — with URLs and dates. Without a prior capture it saves a full baseline instead.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to monitor competitor pricing monthly or quarterly — tiers, gates, limits, etc. Invoke by naming competitors or attaching a prior capture.

say_en.text: Track pricing pages for A, B, C and diff against April's capture.
say_en.note: Runs delta mode — only changes reported.

say_en.text: Did any tracked competitor change pricing or packaging this quarter?
say_en.note: Fetches pages and reports this cycle's changes.

say_en.text: Build baseline pricing snapshots for these three competitors.
say_en.note: Baseline mode; diffs begin next run.
